main_text.head: IOANNIS IACOBI GRYNÆI S. THEOLOGIAE D. APHORISTICA EXPOSITIO EPISTOLÆ B. PAVLI ad Colossenses, tradita in inclyta Academia Heydelbergensi, Anno clo. Io. XXCV.
main_text.p: INnomine Domini nostri IESV CHRISTI, auspicabimur aphoristicam Epistolæ beati Pauli Apostoli ad Colossenses Expositionē. Faxit idem ille dux & doctor noster, ut ad diuini nominis sanctificationem, & nostram tum institutionem tum correctionem, id quod ipsius gratia freti iam ordimur, feliciter continuare & absoluere possimus.Lectio 1.17. Maii 1585.

Fert autem animus, Analytico ordine adhibito, primùm de fine istius Epistolæ, quæ complectitur formam sanorum de fide, charitate & spe sermonum: deinde uerò, de eiusdem forma, & partium dispositione, cuius egregia sanè σωτάξις & structura est: tertiò de materia, uidelicet de Christiana tum doctrina tum uita, quæ illius character

page.notes: Drop cap "I" is an ornamented woodcut initial, read as N of "Nnomine" is set as the decorated initial; the first word is printed "Nnomine". Marginal "Lectio 1.", "17. Maii" and "1585" are small italic notes. Running head and page number "1" at top. Greek word σωτάξις as printed (possibly σύνταξις). Page ends with the catchword "character" in the printed text, copied as a full word in the line.
